The diff demonstrates the addition of the source to supported lists, removal from exclusion lists, configuration of an API key, and implementation of the ingestion logic with pagination and checkpointing. Tests are also provided. This represents a clear, bounded feature addition

No tier assignment was requested in the observations, so this is a conservative assessment of the implementation's contribution.
